scope: synthetic full-model forward/backward and SGD only
timing_gate: Report paired table/auto median and variability; require table/auto upper 95% CI <= 1.05 before claiming no material step-time regression. Preserve any miss or failed family.
correctness_gate: All losses finite; within each fixed mode all loss, final parameter and gradient SHA256 digests agree across independent runs. Numerical equivalence across modes is a separate check.
interference: Any foreign GPU process invalidates that case and stops only owned children; CPU native dependency builds must finish before timed trials.
